Product SMILES (unmapped) remove atom maps: we can approximate by stripping tags. But we may not need exact SMILES; we can use the mapped product as SMILES? The route expects "smiles" field with SMILES (unmapped). Could use the product side without mapping. Could we just use the product side as given (with mapping) - maybe acceptable. But better to convert to unmapped: remove [*:...]. Let's quickly produce approximate unmapped product: CH3C(CH3)(CH3)O C(=O)N1CH2CH2N(...). Hard.

Maybe we can avoid needing product SMILES: The route could start with target as the product of any template; but we need a single target. Possibly the target is the same across all templates (the molecule we are retrosynthesizing). The product side of each mapped_rxn should be identical (the target). Let's verify other templates.
